title: Qt: Add Find in Packet search feature
description:
# Find in Packet Search

## Summary

Adds in-packet search to Wireshark in two complementary forms:

1. **Main window: Find in selected Packet** extends the existing **Find Packet** toolbar, so when exactly one packet is selected, you can search within that packet's protocol details tree using the same search field and controls (limited to String and Regular Expression).
2. **Single-packet window: Find in Packet** adds a dedicated find bar above the protocol tree in pop-out packet windows, with its own search field and controls matching the Find Packet toolbar style.

Both paths share a common search engine (InPacketSearch).

## Access

### Main window (Find in selected Packet)

- **Find Packet** toolbar (Edit -\> Find Packet, or the toolbar button)
- Check **Find in selected Packet** on the options row at the bottom of the toolbar (to the right of **Multiple occurrences**)
- Available only when a **single** packet is selected in the packet list

### Single-packet pop-out window (Find in Packet)

- **Edit -\> Find in Packet**
- **Find in Packet** checkbox in the row of options below the protocol tree
- Shortcut: **Ctrl + Alt + F** (scoped to the focused pop-out window).

## Key Features

### Shared search engine (InPacketSearch)

- String and regular expression search (case-sensitive option)
- Real-time match collection across the protocol details tree
- Next / previous match navigation with tree scrolling and selection
- Auto-expanding collapsed tree nodes to reveal matches
- Match highlighting via custom tree delegate (InPacketFindDelegate)
  - Theme (light / dark mode safe)

### Main window integration

- **Find in selected Packet** checkbox on the Find Packet toolbar
- Reuses the existing Find Packet search field
- Match counter shown in the status bar (ex. \[3 of 57\], or \[no matches\] String)
- Green / red syntax feedback on the search field similar to existing set up
- Checkbox disabled when no packet is selected

### Single-packet window (InPacketFindBar)

- Inline find bar above the protocol tree with animated show / hide transition
- Dedicated search field (InPacketFindEdit) with filtering checkboxes
- Match counter (1 of 4, no matches, invalid pattern)
- Similar layout to current find bar implementation
- Each pop-out window maintains its own independent find bar state
- **Ctrl + Alt + F** toggles the find bar only when that window is focused

## Keyboard Shortcuts

### Main window (in-packet mode via Find Packet toolbar)

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **Enter** | Next match |
| **Shift + Enter** | Previous match |
| **Ctrl + N** / **Ctrl + B** | Find Next / Find Previous (Edit menu) |
| **Esc** | Close Find Packet toolbar and clear highlighting |

### Single-packet pop-out window

| Shortcut | Action |
|----------|--------|
| **Ctrl + Alt + F** | Toggle Find in Packet bar |
| **Enter** | Next match |
| **Shift + Enter** | Previous match |
| **Esc** | Close find bar and clear highlighting |

## Testing

Tested on **Windows 11** (MSVC build), **macOS** and **Linux** (Debian) across multiple scenarios:

- **Basic text search**
- **Regex search**
- **Main window in-packet mode**
- **Packet selection changes**
- **Pop-out isolation**
- **Zero matches / edge cases**
- **Syntax feedback**

## Documentation Updates

- **User Guide** (doc/wsug_src/wsug_work.adoc)

## Images

1. **Find in selected Packet** checkbox on the Find Packet toolbar (main window), to the right of **Multiple occurrences.**

![image.png](/uploads/bebf959c4a5c85873d7790faccb72adf/image.png){width=909 height=94}

2. Main window in-packet search with green syntax state and status bar match counter (ex. \[2 of 9\]).

   

   ![image.png](/uploads/adccc6f004d708a5bbbe8862d6a3517c/image.png){width=699 height=42}
3. Status bar match counter no matches (ex. \[no matches\]).

   

   ![image.png](/uploads/e25fa5f18dc5f6a253f0066985b79e50/image.png){width=750 height=42}
4. Single-packet pop-out w/ **Find in Packet** checkbox and shortcut toggle.

   ![image.png](/uploads/d49604691a3ccb38f65c32f1a34cc4ed/image.png){width=893 height=102}
5. Pop-out find bar with match counter and highlighted fields in the protocol tree

![image.png](/uploads/0fd3e36c7e318e0679e2432a60386766/image.png){width=899 height=222}

6. Multiple pop-out windows each with their own find bar state

![image.png](/uploads/38d74b6f83141489065af2332f0e2a2b/image.png){width=936 height=709}

1. The existing find toolbar already support search in Packet details and it also has a checkbox for "Multiple occurrences" to find multiple entries in one packet. Why implement a second find for the exact same purpose?
2. Why does the new find toolbar look different than the existing find toolbar? On macOS the UI looks unfinished and does not match the existing UI. See screenshots attached.
3. What does the new "Find in Packet" checkbox do which is different from a find in Packet details?
4. The names "Find Packet" vs "Find in Packet" is very similar and it's hard to understand the difference for new users.
5. When show a packet in a separate window the menu item "Find in Packet" does not show the find toolbar in the new window, only toggle the find toolbar in Packet details in the main window. Same with the keyboard shortcut.
6. It's no menu item or any way to figure how to get the new find toolbar in a separate packet window.
7. Doing a find with no match makes the background colour red. This colour indicates an error with the search field other places in Wireshark, but here it indicates no match found. This is inconsistent behaviour.
8. Doing a find with a match and then select "Find in Packet" does not add green background to the search field. This is inconsistent.
9. Pressing the up or down buttons in case 8 does not find a match even if the packet has a match. Toggling one of the Case/Regex/Word buttons does update UI and makes the find work.
10. The features in the Find Packet and Find in Packet must be aligned to be consistent.
11. Where is the documentation for this feature?

I think this feature is not ready yet.

+/** @file
+ *
+ * Wireshark - Network traffic analyzer
+ * By Gerald Combs <gerald@wireshark.org>
+ * Copyright 1998 Gerald Combs
+ *
+ * SPDX-License-Identifier: GPL-2.0-or-later
+ */
+
+#ifndef IN_PACKET_FIND_BAR_H
+#define IN_PACKET_FIND_BAR_H
+
+#include <QLabel>
+#include <wsutil/utf8_entities.h>
+#include "widgets/syntax_line_edit.h"
+#include <QModelIndex>
+#include <QPropertyAnimation>
+#include <QTimer>
+#include <QToolButton>
+#include <QWidget>
+
+class ProtoTree;
+
+/**
+ * @brief Find bar widget for searching within a specific packet's protocol tree.
+ */
+class InPacketFindBar : public QWidget
+{
+    Q_OBJECT
+    Q_PROPERTY(int barHeight READ barHeight WRITE setBarHeight)
+
+public:
+    /**
+     * @brief Constructs a new InPacketFindBar object.
+     * @param tree The protocol tree to search within.
+     * @param parent The parent widget.
+     */
+    explicit InPacketFindBar(ProtoTree *tree, QWidget *parent = nullptr);
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Destroys the InPacketFindBar object.
+     */
+    ~InPacketFindBar();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Returns the number of currently open instances of the find bar.
+     * @return Number of open instances.
+     */
+    static int openInstances() { return open_instances_; }
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Shows the find bar with an animation.
+     */
+    void showAnimated();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Hides the find bar with an animation.
+     */
+    void hideAnimated();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Sets focus to the search input field.
+     */
+    void focusSearchField();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Checks if a specific model index matches the current search criteria.
+     * @param model_index The model index to check.
+     * @return @c true if the index matches; @c false otherwise.
+     */
+    bool isMatch(const QModelIndex &model_index) const;
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Checks if a specific model index is the currently active/selected match.
+     * @param model_index The model index to check.
+     * @return @c true if it is the current match; @c false otherwise.
+     */
+    bool isCurrentMatch(const QModelIndex &model_index) const;
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Checks whether the widget is currently operating in dark mode.
+     * @return @c true if dark mode is active; @c false otherwise.
+     */
+    bool isDarkMode() const;
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Gets the current height of the animated bar.
+     * @return The height in pixels.
+     */
+    int barHeight() const;
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Sets the height of the animated bar.
+     * @param h The new height in pixels.
+     */
+    void setBarHeight(int h);
+
+signals:
+    /**
+     * @brief Signal emitted when the search matches are updated.
+     */
+    void matchesChanged();
+
+protected:
+    /**
+     * @brief Event filter for handling specific widget events.
+     * @param obj Object that received the event.
+     * @param event The event to process.
+     * @return @c true if the event was handled; @c false to pass it on.
+     */
+    bool eventFilter(QObject *obj, QEvent *event) override;
+
+private slots:
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot triggered when the search text changes.
+     * @param text The new search text.
+     */
+    void onTextChanged(const QString &text);
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot to perform the actual search operation.
+     */
+    void performSearch();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot to navigate to the next match.
+     */
+    void findNext();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot to navigate to the previous match.
+     */
+    void findPrevious();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot to close the find bar.
+     */
+    void closeBar();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Slot triggered when search toggle options (case, regex, word) change.
+     */
+    void onToggleChanged();
+
+private:
+    /**
+     * @brief Updates the internal list of matching model indices.
+     */
+    void updateMatches();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Updates the label displaying the current match count (e.g. "1 of 5").
+     */
+    void updateCounterLabel();
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Navigates the selection to the specified match index.
+     * @param model_index The match index to navigate to.
+     */
+    void navigateTo(qsizetype model_index);
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Expands parent nodes in the tree so the match is visible.
+     * @param model_index The model index whose parents should be expanded.
+     */
+    void expandParents(const QModelIndex &model_index);
+
+    /**
+     * @brief Recursively collects all model indices within the tree.
+     * @param parent The parent model index to start from.
+     * @param out List to populate with model indices.
+     */
+    void collectIndices(const QModelIndex &parent, QList<QModelIndex> &out);
+
+    /** @brief Pointer to the protocol tree. */
+    ProtoTree *proto_tree_;
+
+    /** @brief Line edit for entering search text. */
+    SyntaxLineEdit *search_edit_;
+    /** @brief Button to toggle case-sensitive search. */
+    QToolButton *case_button_;
+    /** @brief Button to toggle regular expression search. */
+    QToolButton *regex_button_;
+    /** @brief Button to toggle whole word search. */
+    QToolButton *word_button_;
+    /** @brief Label showing current match count and total matches. */
+    QLabel *counter_label_;
+    /** @brief Button to go to the previous match. */
+    QToolButton *prev_button_;
+    /** @brief Button to go to the next match. */
+    QToolButton *next_button_;
+    /** @brief Button to close the find bar. */
+    QToolButton *close_button_;
+
+    /** @brief Timer for debouncing search input. */
+    QTimer *debounce_timer_;
+    /** @brief Animation for showing and hiding the bar. */
+    QPropertyAnimation *animation_;
+
+    /** @brief State flag tracking if the bar is open. */
+    bool is_open_;
+
+    /** @brief Count of open bar instances. */
+    static int open_instances_;
+
+    /** @brief List of model indices that match the current search. */
+    QList<QModelIndex> matches_;
+    /** @brief The index of the currently active match in matches_. */
+    qsizetype current_match_;
+    /** @brief State flag for an invalid regular expression. */
+    bool regex_invalid_;
+    /** @brief The natural height of the find bar for animation purposes. */
+    int natural_height_;
